description: Generate a cryptographically random, base64-encoded nonce for a Content-Security-Policy script-src or style-src directive, along with ready-to-paste header directive and <script>/<style nonce="..."> tag snippets. Generates a fresh, unique value on every call.

byteLength.description: Number of random bytes to encode (default 16 = 128 bits, the CSP spec's recommended minimum)

name: generate_csp_nonce
